fishing: WHEN: Friday morning Oct 9. Boca Grande low about 6:15a, high about 12:48p. Solunar very high; major window about 11:24a-1:24p. Small craft advisory 8a through Saturday afternoon. SE 10-15 kt becoming S around 20 kt, choppy, storms building this afternoon — run the pass and any Gulf leg before early afternoon. PASSES-BEACH: Fishin Franks / Waterline (reports around Oct 6): Spanish mackerel off the beach, snook in the passes. Cooks Sportsland Venice: whiting, some snook and redfish off the beach; shrimp or sandfleas on the step-off at high tide. LEMON BAY: Fine Bait North Port — good redfish with mixed snook, trout and black drum; Bull and Turtle Bay reds, smaller snook and trout. Fishin Franks: lots of redfish and small trout in Bull/Turtle, some reds on the West Wall. NEARSHORE: cobia schools migrating (Economy Tackle best bet); mangrove snapper inside 20 miles and on nearshore wrecks; gag grouper season open. Capt. Mike / Manasota Key Outfitters still no October bite note. Baits: live shrimp, sandfleas, soft plastics, cut bait.
redtide: FWC Oct 2 still the posted Friday report at 6a (next update this afternoon): K. brevis background only in SWFL (Sarasota); no fish kills, no respiratory reports. Local samples through Oct 7: above background at 1 of 39, trace near Boca Grande Pier.
bacteria: Manasota Key Beach GOOD, no advisory — enterococci 10 on 10/5 (Healthy Beaches, page updated 10/8). Englewood Beach GOOD, last listed 20 CFU on 9/21, no advisory.
fpl: Morning check: county feed Charlotte 2 / Sarasota 148 at 5:03a; FPL tracker snapshot Charlotte 62 / Sarasota 3 at 12:14a. No Englewood/Manasota spike noted.
